hero.subtitle: The Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 client and its game logic, rewritten in Rust and checked against the vanilla game by 281 differential harnesses.

about.title: Same inputs, identical outputs.
about.description: Horizon, sometimes called Minecraft Rust Edition, rebuilds Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 in Rust, one subsystem at a time, and holds every piece to the same inputs as the vanilla game until the outputs are identical.
about.wallpaperAlt: A Minecraft windmill above a field of lavender
about.point1Body: Install Java Edition with the official launcher and play 26.3 once. Horizon builds its resources from those files on your machine, and never downloads or shares game files.
about.point2Body: Linux, macOS on Apple Silicon and Windows. Worlds come from a Rust port of the vanilla generators, drawn with vanilla's block models, lighting, sky and fog.
about.point3Body: Horizon's code is MIT. It contains no Minecraft code, assets or data; those belong to Mojang and Microsoft under the Minecraft EULA.

footer.privacyPart1: This site sets no cookies, has no analytics or trackers and loads nothing from third parties except GitHub. When you open a release, the server keeps a one-way hash of your IP address so that release counts each visitor once; the address itself is never stored. To show the latest releases, patch notes, links and contributors, your browser asks api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com for them, and avatars.githubusercontent.com for the contributors' pictures;
